headline: Frontline Shifts Intensify Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours on, the slaughterhouse at Weathered Expanse has deepened its toll to 170,149 Colonial and 187,405 Warden dead with fifteen ownership changes, both casualty streams still accelerating. Linn Mercy remains the busiest sector, logging nineteen flips in the last day and pushing Colonial losses to 54,068 and Warden to 67,924, while recruitment surges. Stonecradle has risen to eighteen flips, its 24‑hour butcher’s bill now 52,274 Colonial and 65,888 Warden, with casualties and enlistments climbing sharply. Stlican Shelf records seven flips, Colonial dead at 54,929 and Warden at 60,991, loss rates steadying. Fresh turnover appears on Farranac Coast — five flips amid a mixed 2‑Warden/9‑Colonial hold — and on Gutter, where five flips centre on The Parras. Fishermans Row adds four flips around Fort Ember. Northern Warden‑held fronts and deep Colonial interiors stay quiet, showing no ownership changes.
